home.headline: Bays Horizon is building the monitored vFarm in public.
home.subhead: We are wiring a real vertical farm to an AI engine that uses data from each growing cycle to inform future improvements. Join Early Access to see the builds, system diagrams, and monthly progress as we build toward increasingly automated operation.
home.meta_description: We are wiring a real vertical farm to an AI engine that uses data from each growing cycle to inform future improvements. Join Early Access to see the builds, system diagrams, and monthly progress.

early_access.headline: Join vFarm Early Access
early_access.body: Tell us whether you are thinking about vFarm for a household or for an industrial site or building, and what you would hope it would do. Early Access interest only. Preliminary planning only, not quotes or commitments.
early_access.qualifier: Early Access interest only. No paid offer is currently approved for public use.
early_access.success_message: Thank you. Your Early Access interest is recorded. This is interest only, not a quote or commitment, and no paid offer is currently approved for public use. If a pilot structure is approved, Early Access participants will be the first we contact.
early_access.error_message: That didn't go through. Your answers are still here: try again, or email support@bhanetwork.org.

supporting_claims: vFarm is being developed as a monitored growing system.
Monitoring of supported operating signals and configuration-backed digital-twin development are part of the current product direction.
Verified build, CAD, render, configuration and monitoring progress may be shown with its real status.

what_vfarm_is.title: A vertical farm rig sized for a spare room.
what_vfarm_is.body: P1.0 is a two-tier open-rack vFarm build, roughly the footprint of a bookshelf.

what_vfarm_is.title: Base vFarm includes the physical frame, trays, lights and pumps; control and automation capabilities are shown only when verified.
Monitoring captures supported operating signals and surfaces verified system events for review.
P1.0 is being built for monitored operation, with increasing automation as the development goal.
